findings.message: ensure_copy returns True as soon as the caller's copy exists, without re-hashing it. If that copy is damaged but another person's copy is intact, /api/has answers yes and the phone deletes its only good copy, contradicting the endpoint's promise that yes means the PC re-hashed the asker's copy. Hash the caller's own path first and relink it from the verified source when it is missing or damaged.
